root_cause: Board uses same source crop, orientation and scale; no verified rotation/crop transform mismatch.
The source station symbol is positioned over a large dark-blue work land-use band that was omitted from the old 40-feature board.
Gray rail facility and visible railway line below the symbol were also omitted.
Thus correct source-local symbol position was rendered over blank beige space beyond the commerce polygons, creating a floating new station.
Do not move the marker onto an unrelated road merely because it looks more plausible.
editor_solution: Add work band, visible gray facility, and rail strokes as a single static background group with the station symbol, before narration starts.
Use the same board transform/camera for every joint element; no separately timed pin insertion.
Keep source circle at606848; call it a published plan symbol, not station center or exit.
Existing pastel uses preserved; clear rail stroke and concise planned legend only; no new GIS pin.
The original callout occludes some rail geometry: show verified visible segment only; do not invent continuation through the station icon.
